pipeline.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/venv/bin/activate
cd /root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/CosyVoice/examples/libritts/cosyvoice3
. ./path.sh || exit 1
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""
PM=/root/autodl-tmp/laohan/weights/cosyvoice3/Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512
D=/root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/data
for SPLIT in train dev; do
  mkdir -p $D/$SPLIT/parquet
  python ../../../tools/extract_embedding.py --dir $D/$SPLIT --onnx_path $PM/campplus.onnx --num_thread 8 2>&1 | tail -1
  python ../../../tools/extract_speech_token.py --dir $D/$SPLIT --onnx_path $PM/speech_tokenizer_v3.onnx --num_thread 8 2>&1 | tail -1
  python ../../../tools/make_parquet_list.py --num_utts_per_parquet 1000 --num_processes 8 --src_dir $D/$SPLIT --des_dir $D/$SPLIT/parquet 2>&1 | tail -1
  cp $D/$SPLIT/parquet/data.list $D/$SPLIT.data.list
done
echo "[$(date +%T)] PIPELINE_DONE, launching train"
unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
bash /root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/train.sh

#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/venv/bin/activate
cd /root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/CosyVoice/examples/libritts/cosyvoice3
. ./path.sh || exit 1
PM=/root/autodl-tmp/laohan/weights/cosyvoice3/Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512
D=/root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/data
echo "[$(date +%T)] train start"
torchrun --nnodes=1 --nproc_per_node=1 --rdzv_id=jeffrey --rdzv_backend=c10d --rdzv_endpoint=localhost:1234 \
  ../../../cosyvoice/bin/train.py \
  --train_engine torch_ddp --config conf/cosyvoice3.yaml \
  --train_data $D/train.data.list --cv_data $D/dev.data.list \
  --model llm --checkpoint $PM/llm.pt \
  --qwen_pretrain_path $PM/CosyVoice-BlankEN --onnx_path $PM \
  --model_dir /root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/exp/jeffrey/llm \
  --tensorboard_dir /root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/tb/jeffrey/llm \
  --num_workers 1 --prefetch 10 --pin_memory --use_amp
echo "[$(date +%T)] TRAIN_DONE"

synth_deborah.py.text:
import sys
sys.path.append("third_party/Matcha-TTS")
MODEL_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/model-deborah-v1"
REF_WAV = "/root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/data-deborah/train/deborah_b0_s000000.wav"
REF_TEXT = """You tell your child, put your shoes on. Your child keeps playing."""
from cosyvoice.cli.cosyvoice import AutoModel
import torchaudio
cv = AutoModel(model_dir=MODEL_DIR)
texts = [
    "Chinese parents are the most devoted parents in the world. But devotion is not the same as method. Love is the engine, and method is the steering wheel.",
    "At ten years old, my daughter cooked dinner for the whole family once a week. Yes, with a real knife and a real stove. You are a good mom.",
]
prompt = "You are a helpful assistant.<|endofprompt|>" + REF_TEXT
for i, t in enumerate(texts):
    for chunk in cv.inference_zero_shot(t, prompt, REF_WAV, stream=False):
        torchaudio.save(f"/root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/deborah-synth-t{i}.wav", chunk["tts_speech"], cv.sample_rate)
        break
print("SYNTH_DONE")

synth_ep01.py.text:
import sys
sys.path.append("third_party/Matcha-TTS")
MODEL_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/model-deborah-v1"
REF_WAV = "/root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/data-deborah/train/deborah_b0_s000000.wav"
REF_TEXT = "You tell your child, put your shoes on. Your child keeps playing."
from cosyvoice.cli.cosyvoice import AutoModel
import torchaudio
cv = AutoModel(model_dir=MODEL_DIR)
script = open("/root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/ep01-script.txt").read().strip()
prompt = "You are a helpful assistant.<|endofprompt|>" + REF_TEXT
out = "/root/autodl-tmp/cosyvoice-train/deborah-ep01-full.wav"
import torch
import torch
speech = torch.cat([c["tts_speech"] for c in cv.inference_zero_shot(script, prompt, REF_WAV, stream=False)], dim=-1)
torchaudio.save(out, speech, cv.sample_rate)
print("SYNTH_DONE", speech.shape[-1]/cv.sample_rate, "seconds")
